imageOrientationCheck.method: Decode big-endian FITS -32 float g band at padded 2880-byte data offset; compare asinh-stretched 256x256 values to JPEG grayscale after subtracting each image's radius-3 Gaussian blur, masking JPEG grayscale <=10 or >=245. Pearson coefficient for fixed pixel orientation; vertical FITS flip aligns FITS bottom-up with JPEG top-down. No optimization on this sample beyond four orientations and 5x5 integer shifts.

conclusion: This specific JPEG uses FITS north-up/east-left after row reversal, with no observed whole-pixel offset. FITS CRPIX=(N+1)/2 differs from current CDS W3 registration's N/2. This is not yet native-renderer astrometric or target-device evidence.
